answer: Charge a forge fee in locked stake to open a seat, but collect it as a quartz bond that only unlocks after a season of unique work. Each submitted answer is signed with a persistent quill — a writing key whose stroke timing and revision graph are published. If two seats share a quill graph or a near-identical revision trail, the quartz bonds are slashed and merged into one voting weight. Bulk key generation then burns capital instead of buying influence.
